---
title: "Superstore — Extended Business Case"
subtitle: "Three descriptive R applications · 307312 Applied Statistics — Masters Level"
---

- **Start after:** [Part 2: Descriptive Statistics and its R examples](../../lessons/02-descriptive-statistics.qmd).
- **Business:** Superstore, Tableau’s fictitious retailer; the fixed official extract downloaded 6 November 2026 contains US orders placed in 2023–2025.
- **Scope:** 6,682 product lines, 3,322 orders and 782 customer IDs. Keep these observational units distinct.
- Work through the three notebooks in order. Each includes explained R code, worked results and independent business tasks.
- [Positron files (.zip)](../../downloads/applied-statistics-positron.zip) contain the editable notebooks, data and data guide.

| Notebook | Focus | Open |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Product mix | Categories, frequencies, percentages and charts | [HTML](practical-01-categorical-business-data.qmd) · [PDF](../../pdf/practical-01-categorical-business-data.pdf) |
| 2. Order size | Centre, spread, percentiles and boxplots | [HTML](practical-02-numerical-business-data.qmd) · [PDF](../../pdf/practical-02-numerical-business-data.pdf) |
| 3. Discounts, profit and groups | Association and group comparisons | [HTML](practical-03-association-and-groups.qmd) · [PDF](../../pdf/practical-03-association-and-groups.pdf) |

- Return status means membership in the source Returns sheet, not verified refund accounting.
- The analyses are descriptive; they do not establish causal discount effects or represent actual retailers.
